raw_text: Read `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Build: `npm run build`; test: `npm run test`; always test debug: `npm run build:interceptor:debug`. Run `gofmt` before committing. TypeScript strict mode; React Bootstrap; no Tailwind. Zero external dependencies; Simple MAPI; non-blocking, thread-safe; JSON to `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`. Test multiple apps, leaks, filesystem errors, native messaging, Chrome/Edge. Register DLL: `npm run register:mapi`; load extension developer mode; inspect `%TEMP%\go-mapi\`, DevTools. Keep changes minimal; add tests/docs; preserve schema/protocol; update C++ writer, Go structs, TS types. Use Conventional Commits.
